basic_details.job_title: DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 14 Nursing, Pharmacy Officer and More Posts
basic_details.organization_name: District Health and Family Welfare Office Dharwad
basic_details.post_name: Staff Nurse, Junior Laboratory Technical Officer, Pharmacy Officer
basic_details.short_information: District Health and Family Welfare Office Dharwad (DHFWO Dharwad) has released the official Staff Nurse, Junior Laboratory Technical Officer, and Pharmacy Officer Notification 2026 on its official website, https://dharwad.nic.in. A total of 14 vacancies have been announced under the DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates up to 45 years of age with a Diploma in Nursing/B.Sc. Nursing, Diploma in Laboratory Technician, or Diploma in Pharmacy can apply online up to 05-08-2026. The official notification PDF and online application link are available below.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules will be as per government norms.

qualification.education_qualification: Diploma Nursing / BSc Nursing, Diploma in Laboratory Technician, Diploma in Pharmacy
qualification.details: Staff Nurse: Diploma Nursing / BSc Nursing with Karnataka Nursing Council Registration and Midwifery Certificate. Junior Laboratory Technical Officer: Diploma in Laboratory Technician with Karnataka Paramedical Board Registration. Pharmacy Officer: Diploma in Pharmacy with Karnataka Pharmacy Council Registration.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DHFWO Dharwad Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DHFWO Dharwad to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: DHFWO Dharwad Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DHFWO Dharwad Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 14 vacancies are available – 12 for Staff Nurse, 1 for Junior Laboratory Technical Officer, and 1 for Pharmacy Officer.

content_sections.heading: DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Staff Nurse: Diploma Nursing / BSc Nursing with Karnataka Nursing Council Registration and Midwifery Certificate. Junior Laboratory Technical Officer: Diploma in Laboratory Technician with Karnataka Paramedical Board Registration. Pharmacy Officer: Diploma in Pharmacy with Karnataka Pharmacy Council Registration.

content_sections.heading: DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules will be as per government norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DHFWO Dharwad Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DHFWO Dharwad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026 is August 5, 2026. Candidates are urged to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies for the Staff Nurse position in the District Health and Family Welfare Office Dharwad recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts advertised by DHFWO Dharwad in this recruitment is 45 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Staff Nurse position, candidates must possess a Diploma in Nursing or BSc Nursing, along with a Karnataka Nursing Council Registration and a Midwifery Certificate.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026 primarily involves Document Verification, followed by the preparation of a Merit List based on the verified documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q8. What are the important dates for the DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application period starts on July 28, 2026, and ends on August 5, 2026. Document verification will take place from August 10 to August 12, 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the District Health and Family Welfare Office Dharwad (DHFWO Dharwad) in Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. Are these posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The job type for the positions advertised in the DHFWO Dharwad Recruitment 2026 is contractual. This means the employment will be for a specified period as per the contract terms.
